description: This file defines a MockLogger class that extends the Logger class for testing purposes. It provides a constructor that initializes the logger with a TestHandler and a method to retrieve this handler. It is located within the test suite of the project, meant for testing logging functionalities.

classes.name: MockLogger
classes.description: A mock implementation of the Logger class for testing, configured with a TestHandler and providing access to it.

methods.description: Initializes the MockLogger with a TestHandler for testing purposes.

methods.description: Returns the test handler used within the MockLogger.
